name: network_intro
labels: The next questions are about the people you talk to. Use first names or nicknames only. The study keeps the names you type out of the network export unless the researcher turns them on.

stages.title: Important matters
stages.prompt: Looking back over the last six months, who are the people you talked to about matters that are important to you?

stages.title: Practical help
stages.prompt: Who would you ask for help if you were ill for a couple of weeks? You can add people you already named.

stages.title: About each person
stages.prompt: Answer these questions about each person you named.

questions.name: closeness
questions.description: How close do you feel to {name}?

questions.name: years_known
questions.description: About how many years have you known {name}?

stages.title: Your network map
stages.prompt: Drag people so those you feel closest to are nearer the centre. Lines show who knows whom; click two people to add or remove a line.
